item.title: Version 1.0.01
item.description:
<![CDATA[## What's new in 1.0.01
- Initial commit: Utilix macOS menu bar utility app - Add Sparkle auto-updates, release tooling, and the isolated test app - Performance overhaul + A-Z UI/UX pass and Keep Awake duration-switch fix - Phase 1: ember accent standardization + rainbow cleanup - Phase 2: type ramp floor 10pt + elevation shadow removal - Phase 3: unify keycap renderer - Phase 4: palette material pass - Rewrite palette pager with SpacesRail two-finger-scroll method - Fix snippet edit/delete, row click targets, nested-button double-fire + utility audit fixes - Document agent workflow: architecture, research-first, production UI rules, build discipline - Add repo-local opencode.json pointing at AGENTS.md - Remove fixed snippet row actions from popover (hover pills in palette own edit/delete) - Rebuild auto-type: stoppable engine, indent bypass, editable palette panel - Auto-type refuses honestly without Accessibility instead of typing nothing - Guard auto-type re-entry; spell out focus requirement in UI - Make auto-type trust check and keycode map unit-testable; pin mapping/guard/refusal - Seam auto-type event sink; prove firing order, wipe, unicode, cancel headlessly - Auto-type newlines via Shift+Enter; expand tabs to spaces (script-faithful, never submits) - Pin Sparkle floor to 2.9.6 (security fixes); sync docs - Slider key/start delays with clamps; auto-restore typing focus; migrate old speed tiers - Compact auto-type panel: header row, side-by-side sliders, short footnote - Pin palette search bar; clip overflowing detail panes at the bottom - Auto-type editor flexes into pane void; ember toggle - Borderless Raycast-style search bar; loupe brightens on focus - Drop palette close button; outside-click and Esc already dismiss - Hover-only ghost icon row actions; drop solid text pills - Phase 0 foundations: unify buttons/ghosts/icons/empties/motion, drop dead code - Phase 1 palette: grouped sidebar, sectioned results, unified panes, ember AI - Phase 2 popover: unified rows, merged placeholders, trimmed panes - Phase 3 settings: unified rows, native About panel, cleanup feedback - Phase 4 audit: full ember, pressed states, motion tokens, a11y labels - Mac Vision captures everywhere via ScreenCaptureKit; clipboard append mode + text preview - Mac Vision excludes own windows from capture; testable clipboard write path - Mac Vision: testable OCR pipeline, blank-result guard, clipboard monitor baseline sync - Stable self-signed identity ends the rebuild permission dance - Shipped updates carry the stable identity; EdDSA public key matches keychain - Stale-grant recovery script, stable DMG signing, free-forever release docs - FDA onboarding auto-adds the list row; synchronous in-process trigger - Never per-bundle reset FDA; add FDA probe support hook - Fix quit-during-onboarding crash; nil-guard utilities cleanup]]>
